name: serverkit-faro
description: One-click Open in Faro, plus time-boxed access grants. Adds a Connect with Faro button to Services, Domains, and WordPress sites that opens the Faro desktop client prefilled to SFTP into that site's web root, via faro:// deep links — no credentials ever leave the panel: a link only prefills Faro's connection editor. It can also issue Faro access grants (faro://grant): hand someone revocable, key-based SSH/SFTP access to a bundle of managed servers with a single link — Faro fetches the grant manifest from this panel, uploads a freshly-generated public key after the user accepts, and this extension installs that key on the granted servers. Revoking the grant removes the key; the owner's own credentials are never touched.
author: Juan Denis

walkthroughs.title: Share access to a server
walkthroughs.description: Create a time-boxed Faro link that gives someone SSH and SFTP access to the servers you pick, then copy it to send.

steps.title: Open the form
steps.description: Start a new access link from the Access page.

steps.title: Pick who and where
steps.description: Name the person, tick the servers, and choose how long the access lasts. Add a bridge if your servers only accept SSH from one address.

steps.title: Create the link
steps.description: ServerKit issues a single-use faro://grant link. Nothing is installed until the person accepts it in Faro.

steps.title: Copy and send it
steps.description: The link is shown once. Send it privately; whoever opens it first gets the access.
